items.title: Mrs. Cozzy Cary Interview, 1961-08-09
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Mrs. Gary, do you remember some of these? You sang about the Promised Land.

ctx.x: I didn't play around the center of the night. If you were I can play for my Lord. For my Lord, what shall I do?
Got this second reel on there, Miss Gary. Let me see. Let me see. I'm so glad I got my religion in time.
I'm so glad I got my religion in time. I'm so glad I got my religion in time. Oh my Lord, oh my Lord, what shall I do?
